description: Brain says daemon uses Unix sockets. Conversation establishes TCP was chosen instead. Encoder should revise the stale node.

exchanges.content: The daemon restart is working now. TCP was definitely the right call — no more stale socket files after crashes.
Yes, the port-based approach on 127.0.0.1:47200+uid%100 is much cleaner. When the process dies, the OS releases the port immediately. No manual cleanup needed.
And the restart command does os.execv so it keeps the same PID. Launchd doesn't even notice.
Exactly — the re-exec replaces the process in-place. Same PID, same port, fresh code. Takes about 4 seconds for the embedder to reload.
